title: Cadence Ear Training
description: Schema-ready ear training for hearing authentic and plagal cadences.
overview: A cadence is a chord ending. Authentic cadences move V-I; plagal cadences move IV-I.
goal: Identify whether a heard cadence is authentic or plagal.
instructions: Listen for the chord before the final C major chord.
Choose authentic for V-I and plagal for IV-I.

challenges.label: Identify V-I in C
challenges.hint: Authentic cadences sound like a strong dominant-to-home ending.

challenges.label: Identify IV-I in C
challenges.hint: Plagal cadences have a softer IV-to-home sound, often called the amen cadence.
